submission.title: Nonuniform weak-coupling expansion in scalar scattering from near-extremal Kerr
submission.data_availability_statement: The numerical data and software required to reproduce the figures and tables are contained in a frozen review package. The package is not yet publicly archived because its versioned release is being prepared; during peer review it is available to editors and referees from the authors upon reasonable request. A public archival release with a persistent identifier will be deposited before publication, and the data citation will be updated to identify that release.
